name: Ribollita
assumptions: Yield of 4 based on explicit instruction to divide among 4 bowls
Total time is sum of active and passive steps: 5-10 min sauté + 15-20 min simmer + 10-15 min bake = ~45 min midpoint estimate
Parmesan cheese confirms dairy and milk allergen
Wholegrain bread confirms wheat allergen and gluten
No explicit egg, fish, shellfish, peanuts, or sesame in ingredients
Tree nuts and soy ambiguous due to possible cross-contact or unspecified stock
Rosemary and thyme sprigs are mostly discarded and do not affect final classification
All ingredients screened as listed; no substitutions applied
Recipe is vegetarian per source and ingredients (cheese is vegetarian-compatible)
instructions:
Put 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large pot over medium heat. When it’s hot, add onion, carrot, celery and garlic; sprinkle with salt and pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft, 5 to 10 minutes.
Heat the oven to 500 degrees. Drain the beans; if they’re canned, rinse them as well. Add them to the pot along with tomatoes and their juices and stock, rosemary and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat so the soup bubbles steadily; cover and cook, stirring once or twice to break up the tomatoes, until the flavors meld, 15 to 20 minutes.
Fish out and discard rosemary and thyme stems, if you like, and stir in kale. Taste and adjust seasoning. Lay bread slices on top of the stew so they cover the top and overlap as little as possible. Scatter red onion slices over the top, drizzle with the remaining 3 tablespoons oil and sprinkle with Parmesan.
Put the pot in the oven and bake until the bread, onions and cheese are browned and crisp, 10 to 15 minutes. (If your pot fits under the broiler, you can also brown the top there.) Divide the soup and bread among 4 bowls and serve.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 5 tbsp olive oil at 13.6 g per tbsp; 100% fat used in cooking and drizzling.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium chopped onion ≈ 110 g raw weight.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium chopped carrot ≈ 61 g raw weight.

ingredients.name: Celery
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium celery stalk chopped ≈ 40 g raw weight.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp minced garlic ≈ 9 g raw weight.

ingredients.name: Cannellini Beans
ingredients.assumptions: 2 cups cooked or drained canned cannellini beans (≈ 520 g total edible portion).

ingredients.name: Canned tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: 1 × 400 g can whole peeled tomatoes with juice (standard size, entire contents used).

ingredients.name: Rosemary
ingredients.assumptions: 1 fresh rosemary sprig ≈ 5 g (plausible small sprig; mostly discarded after cooking).

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.assumptions: 1 fresh thyme sprig ≈ 5 g (plausible small sprig; mostly discarded after cooking).

ingredients.name: Kale
ingredients.assumptions: 1 lb (454 g) raw chopped kale (edible portion).

ingredients.name: Wholegrain Bread
ingredients.assumptions: 4 thick slices wholegrain bread ≈ 50 g per slice (typical thick cut).

ingredients.name: Red Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium red onion thinly sliced ≈ 110 g raw weight.

ingredients.name: Parmesan
ingredients.assumptions: ½ cup (≈ 50 g) freshly grated Parmesan cheese.
